subject.title: feat: add disableBoundaryAwareCache compat option for prefix-matching prompt cache providers

question: Should the proven DeepSeek prefix-cache transformation remain a public `compat.disableBoundaryAwareCache` option with an automatic DeepSeek default?
rationale: The patch and live evidence support the behavioral fix, but OpenClaw policy sets a high bar for new config/default surface and requires maintainer ownership of the permanent provider contract.

options.title: Approve the compat contract
options.body: Keep the DeepSeek automatic default and explicit-false override as supported model compatibility behavior, then refresh exact-head validation.

options.title: Internalize the behavior
options.body: Retain the latest-user transformation but remove the public option if maintainers do not want a permanent operator-facing control.
